'''Raste''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]] who served aboard the [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Raste was present in the ''Esseles'' when the starship was [[Assault on the Esseles|under attack]] by ''[[Emperor's Glory]]'' under the command of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran|Kilran]]. After [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tyrus (Esseles)|Tyrus]] was killed in the ''Glory''{{'s}} first attack, Raste received an incoming message from the enemy, forcing all members of the ship to stand down.<ref name="TOR" />
